caption:
Your follow-up system sent one text. Then it stopped.

Most shops treat follow-up like a single swing: one text goes out, and if there's no reply within the hour, the lead sits untouched for good.

Most leads don't convert on message one. They convert after several follow-ups, spread across different days and different angles: a price question, a timing nudge, a last call before you move to the next job.

The free Follow-Up Builder takes your business type and builds a full multi-step text sequence in under a minute.

No signup. No card.

DM TOOLS.

#LeadFollowUp #ServiceBusiness #SmallBusinessMarketing #SpeedToLead #CRMAutomation
rationale: Single-offer promo images still book the fastest DM response for one clear ask. The Follow-Up Builder gets a fresh reframe around the one-and-done follow-up habit, with the conversion-pattern claim softened to an honest general observation instead of an invented stat.
